title: Aavarampoo
desc: Sakkarai, a mentally challenged orphan, works for the village chief, Thevar. Trouble begins in his life when he falls in love with his master's daughter, Thamarai.

title: Paravaigal Palavitham
desc: A group of friends in college dream of being successful. However, due to financial and employment problems, they begin to watch their dreams fade.

title: Laysa Laysa
desc: Chandru's grandfather is going to visit him but Chandru has spent all his money. So he requests his wealthy friend, Rakesh, to pose as the owner of all the riches till his grandfather stays with him.

title: Diwan
desc: A cook falls in love with a wealthy man's daughter. However, after receiving her father's disparaging remarks, he embraces the challenge to amass a fortune within a year.
